'''Haplysia''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Tideon]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Haplysia's territory is a vast misty sea. Soft and billowy as those clouds may look, every single water droplet is untouchable."

Haplysia is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A quadruped, blue, orange, and white rabbit-like creature. It has blue eyes with long lashes, and it wears a fancy bowtie. It also has long white ears with orange circle markings. Additionally, it has markings draped over its body that resemble a sea slug's.

Haplysia's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with orange, and orange with green.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'Haplysiae have the fascinating ability to descern intent, thus secreting toxins through skin as needed.' - Unnamed Log"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/2026, its bio description said: "Haplysia's color changes with mood. Can release cloud mist so fragrant that even Zobos can't resist."
